horizon: one planning month (730 fixed-cost hours); review before extending
basis: Conservative low-use prototype forecast. No discount/free request allowance assumed. Variable allowances are planning ceilings, not exact regional tariffs or technical caps. Fixed rates are in aws-fixed-costs-2026-11-19.json.

items.item: RDS instance, storage and two private endpoints
One WAF ACL and one rule
10000 Lambda requests, 2 seconds at 512 MiB, ceiling USD .00002/GB-second plus .20/million requests
100 emails and small message transfer allowance
S3 versions/requests, 2 GiB retained artifacts/static data allowance
CloudFront 5 GiB transfer plus 10000 requests allowance
Four alarms plus bounded logs allowance
CPU surplus, rotation/migration invocations and other usage contingency

limitations: No out-of-pocket upgrade authorized. Free plan ends on credits/term exhaustion. Traffic, CAPTCHA abuse, CPU surplus, version growth or logging can exhaust credits sooner; throttle/alarms/guard do not constitute a monetary cap. No indefinite lifetime-free promise. Additional usage/services require fresh estimate and plan check.
